turns.q: What should I do if the tracking never updates?
turns.replyTail: - Tracking numbers can take up to 48 hours to become active after dispatch; an inactive number isn't always a sign of a delay. - Check your Rapha.cc account page — the Order Status will change to "Dispatched" and the tracking link will appear. - Check your spam/junk folder and any email filters. If the tracking still hasn’t updated after 48 hours, share the order number here and I’ll check it for you. If you’d like, I can connect you to someone from our Customer Care team for further assistance.
